summary: Backend 11/11 pytest suite passes (100%). Frontend login flow, dashboard render, greeting, stat cards, and profile switcher verified via Playwright. Medicine-add / mark-taken / logout flows were not fully verified due to test-script selector issues (CSS syntax + loop-prevention rule triggered after minor script failures) but UI loaded correctly with no backend errors.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py set_auth_cookies uses secure=False and samesite='lax'; since frontend is served over https via Kubernetes ingress, cookies still work but for stricter cross-site scenarios consider secure=True/samesite='none' in production.

CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router; in FastAPI this still works because middleware is applied at request time, but convention is to add middleware before mounting routers — keep an eye on preflight behavior.
login_attempts lockout uses ip:email identifier which is correct for brute-force protection; 429 returns confirmed.
No input trim on email at login (uses .lower() only) — minor.
All Mongo queries correctly project {'_id': 0} — good.
